Some of them have altered statistics through the [[Scale]] attribute. |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Soul Reap}}''' - The '''Reaper''' swings its scythe at a nearby tower, stunning it and other towers near it. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Reaper''' was the third boss that appeared in the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]], though only the first '''Reaper''' that spawned was considered a [[Boss]]. It was a tanky and slow enemy with multiple immunities, which made it immune to burn damage from towers like the [[Pyromancer]] and immune to being completely stopped by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]], being only slowed down instead. While it was a boss enemy, it was also immune to being frozen by freezing towers and being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]]. It also had 15% defense. The '''Reaper''' had two abilities. The first ability, ''Sin Bringing'', made it summon five enemies, some of which had their statistics altered through the [[Scale]] attribute. It could spawn the two variants of [[Sin (Lunar Overture)|Sin]]s, the smaller variant with above average speed and 400 health or the big variant with 800 health but below average speed, a smaller [[Demon (Lunar Overture)|Demon]] with its health halved but increased speed or a [[Hallow Guard (Lunar Overture)|Hallow Guard]] with a random amount of health, which is higher than 2,500 and lower than 3,000, slightly smaller size and slightly faster speed. The second ability, ''Soul Reap'', made it swing its scythe at a tower, stunning it and any other tower near it. ==Appearance== The '''Reaper''' was a large humanoid with a waist in its rig. It had a black skin tone, a dark grey ragged cloak with sleeves, pants and a hood with a dark red trim, light grey legs, and a dark red cape. It had a grey chain draped across its torso and had black spikes coming out of its shoulders. It wielded a white scythe with a skull on top, which had grey horns and a black blade on it. The '''Reaper''' had a death animation, where it would drop its scythe and fall on its back, but would flash red and turn into ash in the process, with its body quickly disassembling and fading away. During its ''Sin Bringing'' ability, a red ritual circle appeared beneath it. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended against it. **High DPS towers with ability to hit multiple enemies at once, like the [[Pursuit]] or [[Ranger]] can hit multiple enemies that the '''Reaper''' spawns at once, making them more effective against it. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively. *When it first spawns on Wave 18, it is a boss enemy, therefore it cannot be frozen by freezing towers, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]] or completely stopped by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]. **This also means that it is unaffected by the [[Witch (Lunar Overture)|Witch]]'s ability. **After Wave 18, the '''Reaper''' is no longer a boss, reducing its immunities to only being immune to the [[Warden]]'s and [[Electroshocker]]'s stun, only being slowed down by them. *The '''Reaper''' is immune to being set on fire by towers like the [[Pyromancer]], making them less effective against it. **It also makes it immune from having its defense decreased by the [[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] but since its defense is quite low, this is not a huge issue. {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ReaperWalk.gif|Walking animation (31 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) ReaperSummon.gif|''Sin Bringing'' animation (31 October 202 – 21 December 2023) ReaperAttack.gif|''Soul Reap'' animation (30 October 2024 – 20 December 2023) ReaperDeath.gif|Death animation (31 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) }} ==Trivia== *There was a chance to get the {{RLinkC|15169275236|Reaper's Gear}} accessory, which was based on this enemy, upon triumphing the [[The Haunted Past|second act]] of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2023''' -
